sloka: एवमुक्तः सुरसया दशयोजनमायतः ।ततो ऽर्धगुणविस्तारो बभूवाहं क्षणेन तु ।मत्प्रमाणानुरूपं च व्यादितं तु मुखं तया ।। ५.५८.२९ ।।।।
transliteration: evamuktaḥ surasayā daśayojanamāyataḥ ।tato 'rdhaguṇavistāro babhūvāhaṁ kṣaṇena tu ।matpramāṇānurūpaṁ ca vyāditaṁ tu mukhaṁ tayā ।। 5.58.29 ।।।।

translations.english: "She too opened her mouth wide enough for my size. Seeing her distending her mouth, in a moment I became small equal to the size of thumb and came out.
